newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Snaige rises on mixed Lithuanian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Snaige rises on mixed Lithuanian bourse.

text.p: Shares were mixed amid listless turnover of 376,000 litas on Lithuania's stock exchange on Wednesday.
The official list was up 5.61 points to 880.18 while group A shares fell 24.57 points to 1859.89 points.
Brokers said banking shares were the only sign of a possible recovery.
Vilniaus Bank turned over 918,000 litas in block trades, at 228.00 litas to 230.00 litas, and held steady at 222.00 litas on the central market, where it turned over 88,800 litas.
"It's a very good sign that investors are buying banks," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema. "The banks usually lead."
Brokers say Vilniaus Bank has become more attractive since edging toward the bottom of its usual trading range of 220.00 litas to 240.00 litas.
Brokers have also been watching Hermis Bank shares closely.
Hermis shares were unchanged at 180.00 litas on the central market but saw only light turnover. But brokers say interest remains steady.
"If the price stays at 180.00 litas to 190.00 litas it will be quite attractive to buy," said Grazhina Bachiuliene, a broker with Vilfima.

In other trading, fridge maker Snaige jumped to 13.20 litas from 12.00 litas in central market turnover of 107,000 litas. Brokers say the Snaige advance was prompted by one big order, possibly from a foreign investor.
Brokers are mixed on the future of Snaige's shares. Some say the real value is around 12.00 litas, while others say it has room to grow.
"Some brokers expect the prices to go up to 15.00 litas," Andrejauskas said.
